files-import/fileExtensionsDetails: File details included are file name, extension, size in KB, creation date, last modification date, permissions, SHA-256 checksum, author and file path.
files-import/selectDirectory: Browse the directory hierarchy & Select the directories from which file details need to be generated.
files-import/warning-directory-selection: You must select 1 or more directories.
files-import/fetch-drive-details-failed: Failed to get drive details. Try again.
files-import/fetch-directory-details-fai: Failed to get directory details. Try again.
files-import/drive-not-selected: No drive or directory selected. Please select a drive / directory.
files-import/batch-single-dir-note: Batch mode supports a single root directory only; its sub-folders/files will be detected and extracted automatically.
files-import/batch-single-dir-alert: Batch extraction mode supports a single root directory only.
files-import/batch-elements-required: Please select at least one extraction field.
files-import/el-security-prompt: Extract the security classification of the document (values: 公开/内部/秘密/机密/绝密, i.e. public, internal, secret, confidential, top secret). Output it only when the page actually carries a classification marking such as 内部, 秘密, 机密, 绝密 or 公开 (usually in the upper-left corner of the type area or below the title); when the page has no such marking, omit this element entirely instead of falling back to a default such as 公开.
files-import/el-open-status-prompt: Extract the access marking of the archives (values: 开放/控制/延期开放, i.e. open, controlled, deferred opening). Only accept archive access-review wording such as 信息公开选项, 开放标识 or 开放状态 on the title page or the signature page, for example “信息公开选项：主动公开” whose value is 开放. Note: 是否公开审理, 公开开庭 or 不公开审理 appearing in hearing transcripts or judgment text describes the manner of trial, not the access marking of the archives — never extract on that basis. When the page carries no archive access-review wording, omit this element entirely and never guess a default.
files-import/el-case-cause-prompt: Extract the cause of action, i.e. the nature of the legal relationship in dispute. It is usually in the 案由 field on the case file cover or in the header of the judgment, for example 民间借贷纠纷 or 继承纠纷. The value must be in the form of “××纠纷” or “××案”; never take the 送达文件名称 field of a service receipt or a notice, and never put the name of a document here.
files-import/el-party-prompt: Extract the names of the parties; they are usually on the case file cover or in the header of the judgment. Take only the name itself — do not include procedural-status labels such as 原告/被告/上诉人/被上诉人/第三人 (plaintiff, defendant, appellant, appellee, third party), do not append ID numbers, phone numbers, addresses, gender or dates of birth, and do not join them with connectives such as 与/和. Separate multiple parties with the full-width comma “，”.
files-import/el-trial-level-prompt: Extract the trial level (values: 一审/二审/再审/执行, i.e. first instance, second instance, retrial, enforcement). It is usually on the case file cover or near the case number in the header of the judgment.
files-import/el-closing-method-prompt: Extract the method of closing the case (values: 判决/裁定/调解/撤诉/终结/维持原判/驳回上诉, i.e. judgment, ruling, mediation, withdrawal, termination, upholding the original judgment, dismissing the appeal). Extract it only when this page contains the court's ruling conclusion (e.g. “判决如下” or “裁定如下”) or the 结案方式 field on the case file cover. Claims made by a party in a defence or appeal statement, and the contents of notices or service receipts, are not closing methods — do not extract when this page provides no basis.
files-import/el-retention-prompt: Extract the retention period of the archives; take the value exactly as marked on the case file cover or the filing stamp (for people's court litigation archives: 永久/定期60年/定期20年, i.e. permanent, 60 years, 20 years). If no retention period appears on this page, do not extract it — do not supply a default or a guess.
files-import/batch-custom-elements: Custom extraction types (optional, add elements / adjust rules)
